description: An icon-only action, round (DESIGN.md, IconButton). label names it for screen readers. With toggled it is a toggle, accent-filled when on.

constructors.description: An icon button showing icon, named label.

params.name: icon
params.description: The icon drawn (never read itself; label names the button).

params.name: label
params.description: The accessible name; shown as a tooltip on fine pointers (and at once on keyboard focus), unless tooltip is false.

params.name: onPressed
params.description: Called on a press; null disables it.

params.name: toggled
params.description: Makes it a toggle; accent-filled, TsuyaColors.onAccent icon, when true.

params.name: badge
params.description: Pinned on the corner; fold its meaning into label.

params.name: expanded
params.description: Marks it as open or closed, for a button that discloses a panel (a narrow menu, say).

params.name: tooltip
params.description: Shows label as a tooltip on fine pointers; set false to turn it off.

params.name: focusNode
params.description: The node to track focus with, when the caller manages one.

params.name: autofocus
params.description: Focuses it as soon as it is built.
